verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions an official Terraform provider or any equivalent declarative, reviewable config-as-code tool for Google Workspace. The Admin SDK Directory API, Cloud Identity API (including dynamic groups), Discovery documents, and Apps Script automation are developer building blocks for constructing such tooling, not the capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, the IdP is managed as code — an official Terraform provider (or equivalent) covers apps, groups, and policies so identity config is reviewable and reproducible
